question: Azorius Justiciar lets me detain up to two target creatures my opponents control. Do both creatures have to be controlled by the same opponent?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the two creatures can be controlled by the same opponent or by different opponents.
expected.answer: The two creatures can be controlled by the same opponent or by different opponents.
